people.name: Stephen
people.line: One of seven deacons, full of faith, performed miracles, martyred.

translations.web: Devout men buried Stephen and lamented greatly over him.
translations.bsb: God-fearing men buried Stephen and mourned deeply over him.
translations.kjv: And devout men carried Stephen to his burial, and made great lamentation over him.
translations.asv: And devout men buried Stephen, and made great lamentation over him.
